findings.evidence: Cube/Generator.lean:338,344 define `characteristicWeight_lowerFace_le`/`_upperFace_le`; `grep -rn 'lowerFace_mem_cubeWeightSublevel\|upperFace_mem_cubeWeightSublevel' TauCeti/` returns only the two definition sites.
findings.fix: Delete both declarations; membership in `cubeWeightSublevel` is `Iff.rfl`, so the existing face-weight lemmas plus `.trans` already give this at every call site.
findings.issue: `lowerFace_mem_cubeWeightSublevel` (74) and `upperFace_mem_cubeWeightSublevel` (81) are restatements of the existing `PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_lowerFace_le` / `_upperFace_le` composed with `le_trans`, and are used nowhere: the file's own `latticeDifferentialOnGenerator_mem_weightSublevel` (lines 257–259) calls `(PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_lowerFace_le P k C v.property).trans hC` directly, bypassing them.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:79 `theorem map_span_le (f) (s) (N) : map f (span R s) ≤ N ↔ ∀ m ∈ s, f m ∈ N`; `grep -rn span_induction TauCeti/LowDimTopology/Plumbing/` hits only Grading.lean:158 and Filtration.lean:267.
findings.fix: After `rw [weightSublevel, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single]`, prove `(weightSublevel P k N).map (P.latticeDifferential k) ≤ weightSublevel P k N` via `(Submodule.map_span_le _ _ _).2` with the generator case supplied by `latticeDifferentialOnGenerator_mem_weightSublevel`, and apply it to `⟨c, hc, rfl⟩`. Better still, factor the common shape into one lemma reused by `latticeDifferential_mem_degreePart`.
findings.issue: `latticeDifferential_mem_weightSublevel` re-derives `Submodule.map_span_le` by hand with a four-case `Submodule.span_induction`, and is a near-verbatim clone of the pre-existing `latticeDifferential_mem_degreePart` (Grading.lean:153–169) — same `supported_eq_span_single`, same zero/add/smul boilerplate.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Finsupp/Supported.lean:165 `theorem supported_inter (s t) : supported M R (s ∩ t) = supported M R s ⊓ supported M R t`; Mathlib has no `supported`-is-FG lemma (`grep supported mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Finiteness/*.lean` finds none).
findings.fix: Get `hsupport` from `(Finsupp.supported_inter _ _ _ _).symm` applied to `degreePart`/`weightSublevel`, and factor the repeated step into one lemma `(hs : s.Finite) → (Finsupp.supported R R s).FG` used by both `weightSublevel_fg` and `weightDegreePart_fg`.
findings.issue: `weightDegreePart_fg` re-proves `Finsupp.supported_inter` by hand (the `hsupport` `ext`/`mem_supported`/`rfl` block) and then repeats verbatim the finite-set-to-FG argument already written at `weightSublevel_fg` (164–168): `rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single]; exact Submodule.fg_span (hfinite.image fun C => Finsupp.single C 1)`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Finset/Order.lean:32 `theorem Finset.exists_le [Nonempty α] [Preorder α] [IsDirectedOrder α] (s : Finset α) : ∃ M, ∀ i ∈ s, i ≤ M`; ℤ satisfies all three.
findings.fix: `obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Finset.exists_le (c.support.image fun C => C.characteristicWeight P k); exact ⟨N, (mem_weightSublevel P k N c).mpr fun C hC => hN _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hC)⟩` — no nonemptiness hypothesis, so the `by_cases` disappears.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_weightSublevel` re-derives `Finset.exists_le` with an unnecessary `c = 0` case split, `Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff`, and `Finset.max'`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:344 `def inclusion (h : p ≤ p') : p →ₗ[R] p'` and :348 `theorem coe_inclusion (h) (x) : (inclusion h x : M) = x`.
findings.fix: Delete both and write `Submodule.inclusion (weightDegreePart_mono P k hNM q)` in `latticeDifferentialWeightDegree_comp_inclusion` (320); `Submodule.coe_inclusion` then discharges the `simp` step at line 329.
findings.issue: `weightDegreeInclusion` is a thin wrapper around `Submodule.inclusion (weightDegreePart_mono ...)` with no added content, and its companion `weightDegreeInclusion_apply` (218) restates `Submodule.coe_inclusion`.

summary: The filtration itself is new material, but the file adds two unused restatements of existing face-weight lemmas and several proofs that re-derive located Mathlib lemmas (`Submodule.map_span_le`, `Finsupp.supported_inter`, `Finset.exists_le`, `Submodule.coe_inclusion`), plus a duplicated finite-support-is-FG argument.
